items.difficulty_reason: 86 行、显式链级同构：①写明两侧的逐度描述（交错上链 vs 外幂上的齐次映射），给出带 (-1)^p 与分母 (f_{i_0}...f_{i_p})^e 的显式公式 Ψ；②transition map 把 [i_0..i_p] 乘上 f 积，恰好抵消分母的系统幂次 ⇒ 与 colimit 相容；③由局部化的 colimit 描述（algebra-lemma-localization-colimit）得逐度同构；④逐项符号计算验证与微分相容（符号来自 Koszul 微分取负）。承重的公式构造、相容性与符号计算全部在 span 内；4 处引用（2 同章 situation/equation、2 跨章）作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-alternating-cech-complex (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 2127-2140

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the explicit formula identifying alternating cochains with homogeneous maps out of the exterior powers, the compatibility with the transition maps of the system through the scaling of basis wedges, the degree-wise isomorphism in the colimit via the localization description, and the sign computation checking compatibility with the differentials, whose sign comes from the negative differential on the Koszul complex (source lines 2142-2212)
